name: Letterboxd Collections
description: Automatically creates and refreshes Jellyfin collections from a Letterboxd user's public lists and watchlist, on Jellyfin's own scheduled task runner.
overview: Auto-syncs Letterboxd lists/watchlist into native Jellyfin collections

versions.changelog: Initial release: auto-discovers Letterboxd lists and watchlist, creates/updates matching Jellyfin collections on Jellyfin's own scheduled task runner.
